# CORPHUB SOLUTION

> Single-window industrial project support partner based in Palanpur, Banaskantha District, Gujarat, India. Serving the industry for over 3 years.
> Slogan: "CorpHub Solution — Your Requirements, Our Responsibility."

CorpHub Solution provides integrated corporate and industrial support services across Gujarat, specializing in assisting project-based companies executing operations outside their usual locations. We simplify project operations by providing multiple services through a single point of contact tailored to client budgets, timelines, and documentation requirements.

## Core Services

- [Corporate Accommodation](/services/accommodation): The Right Stay. The Right Support. One Coordinated Solution. Rental property arrangements, corporate hotels & guest houses at competitive corporate rates (PO / credit terms accepted), and fully managed accommodation with housekeeping, utilities, and Wi-Fi.
- [Customized Corporate Transportation](/services/transport): Safe. Reliable. Flexible. Complete Coordination. Corporate staff pickup and drop, airport and station transfers, local site visits, outstation travel (Ahmedabad, Mumbai, Surat, Vadodara, Rajkot, Nashik), and long-term vehicle contracts. No fixed packages or standard kilometre limits.
- [Industrial Material Supply](/services/material-supply): Reliable industrial material sourcing and direct supply. Two service models: (1) Free Vendor Connection with quote comparison; (2) Direct Material Supply by CorpHub Solution. Sourcing 9 categories: site cabins & containers, electrical materials & switchgear, industrial cables, diesel generators, civil/structural steel, factory furniture, hardware/fasteners, automation components (materials only), and mechanical valves & pumps.
- [Vendor Management & Site Liaison](/services/vendor-management): Contractor screening, SLA compliance tracking, local paperwork coordination, and dispute management for engineering sites.
- [Corporate Event Management](/services/event-management): Turnkey event logistics for project milestones, stakeholder conferences, vendor meets, safety training seminars, and launch ceremonies.
